_about: AUTHORED (T1267): the depth unit each printed lake chart states, for the vector sheets whose own file states none. One row per sheet (8-digit chart file number = PDF and zip number): the unit, the words read on the PDF exactly as printed (a 'DEPTHS IN ...' phrase, else the STATISTICS block's MAX. / MEAN DEPTH with its unit or foot mark, else the contour labels), where on the page, and the deepest contour of the vector file (a check: it sits at or under the stated maximum). A scale bar's unit is never evidence. Read by pipeline.bathymetry.placings, which holds a sheet out until it has a row here; written by a person reading the chart (hand edits: AGENTS A2).
